items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: all the time I ever played with Len Ferguson was a pleasure. Because Len Ferguson never did get in your way.

ctx.x: I wanted to get there with Leonard. We were going out to eat that night. Well, Leonard came there that night and said hello and that's the last of some of them. Yeah. Well, I got to call him back. That's my dear friend. Yeah, he's a nice fellow. I like Len.

I'm glad he's retired. Len Ferguson. He's a fine, fine, never tiresome drummer. Now, I can tell the world that all the time I ever played with Len Ferguson was a pleasure. Because Len Ferguson never did get in your way. Now, you all want to see my pride and joy out there in my cottage in my backyard?
Let's finish this real. Let's finish this real. It's only got about five minutes. I can ask you a couple of questions and then we can take it on by.
